args.body: Thank you for your email. First, a correction to our earlier summary, which said no issues were found: the attached report does record that a dog flap has been installed (utility room/back door), and marks on the Bedroom 1 wall that the tenant is to remove and make good. We have no record of approval for the dog flap or of a lock change, so we are asking the tenant about both, including whether a spare front door key exists and where it is. We will update you by 22 February. Also, your email names Felix Clarke but our records show Oliver Bennett as landlord for this property. Could you confirm who you are and your role? We will not release keys or tenancy details until that is clear.
